preservedResponsibilities: Original abstract EditUndo captures unsigned16 ID, actual engine pointer and current active view-shell identity or minus-one default, rejects repeat and returns original owned OUString comment or empty owned value. Actual existing SfxUndoAction inheritance is retained with an erased comment-value type parameter; source parameterless Undo/Redo bind existing context entry points. No source comment conversion, default shell, label provider or manager is introduced. Consumed OutlinerViewShell declaration has no implementation.
omittedResponsibilities: Concrete EditEngine/ImpEditEngine constructor/resources, source undo-manager/list integration, general deletion/word-boundary/layout/view/style-notification implementations and ScFieldEditEngine/DocImport CSV admission remain unported and mandatory. Prepared dependencies exist only in tests. Full native thread/lifetime/allocator/ABI and QA parity are unverified. NatNum12 and final CSV audit remain pending.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original EditUndo base state/value contract is separated from concrete action families under original header ownership. Existing shared SfxUndoAction gains only an erased comment-value type parameter; source OUString return/ownership is retained without a string-label adapter or alternate manager.
